args.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08). Nothing in common to report for flagged runs.

- **Checks:** All three final checks passed on every run. Rigid-body invariance was 0.60–0.78 against a threshold of 2.0 %/h. Closure was 0.13–0.20 against 1.0 px/h. Plane sections was 1.21–1.39 against 3.25 %/h. No run used the width-free ratio.
- **Large z-scores:** The batch spread is close to zero, so small differences give large z-scores.
  - r01–r03: growth zone is 695 µm against a median of 684 µm (z 2.13). That is 11 µm, about 1.6 %.
  - r05 and r08: REGR peak is 53.06 against 53.02 %/h (z 2.7), and the flank difference peaks at 410 µm instead of 421 µm (z −3.19). These are 0.04 %/h and 11 µm.
- **r07:** Its REGR peak (111.61 %/h) and largest flank difference (−13.49 %/h) are both about 2.1× the batch. But the REGR peak is at the same distance from the tip (421 µm), the growth zone is the same length (684 µm), and the flank difference peaks at the same place. It used frame stride 1 with no remedies kept, and all checks passed. So it reads as a faster root with the same profile shape, not a fault.
- **Note on r07:** Its check values match r04 and r06 exactly, even though its strain rates are 2.1× theirs. Confirming r07's frame times would rule out a time-base error.

Kinematics only: velocity, strain rate and curvature.
